reviews.text: 独立游戏里算很能打的了，一个人开发四年，质量看来还是很有保证的。
最喜欢这种又能攀科技又能开机甲打架的游戏，根本不够玩。
优化做得挺好的，打到后期炮弹满天飞也没有卡顿掉帧，真喜欢这种大场面的战争场景。

建造无人机是爹，修复无人机是妈，只能有一个是吧，扩展塔就十个也一个鸟样。修复？也要给你修复的机会才能修复啊，我都不懂这个修复无人机有什么用，对面打你建筑就是直接炸，根本没有修复的机会，你单位跟纸的区别就是比纸多能抗一下攻击才炸。地面防御塔永远是被对面打炸两三个了才开始攻击对面，所有防御塔锁定时间就跟老奶奶过马路一样慢，等锁定完成对面对面已经打炸我一两个建筑了，防御塔还有实体射击判定，平地上面一前一后防御塔只有前面的能攻击，因为前面单位挡住后面的射击角度了，还有那个护盾更是重量级，对面单位能走进你塔的护盾里，然后你想攻击对面只能先把防御塔的护盾打掉才能攻击到对面单位，然后对面炸了也把你塔炸掉。人物武器弹药就跟那个燧发枪一样，步枪十来发子弹就过热，手枪和狙三四发就过热，火箭筒和榴弹发射器只有一发子弹，打完重新装填要八十秒给我气笑了

游戏的整体风味很怪异，透露着一种独立开发项目典型的放荡不羁：许多地方欠缺打磨，但确实有独特的核心卖点，很难简单用好或坏去评价。 作为独立游戏试玩或EA算是合格，但要问是否推荐朋友购买，恐怕还是只能填写不推荐。 游戏的引导存在节奏问题，教程流程安排很紧凑，而且是任务清单式的无聊流程。很容易错过关键信息，并且也无法感受到完成任务的动力。 而且游戏的UI已经简陋到了阅读信息都有困难的地步，在游戏里能看到采用意义不明汉字缩写的按钮，而同时建造队列又采用了神秘小图标，两者完全对应不上，玩家对建筑完成时间缺乏预期。 除开以上两个十分影响玩家第一印象的缺憾外，游戏本身也充斥着许多不影响游玩但是很糟蹋心情的BUG或设计，比如火炮自动模式总是炸友军（真论自动火炮KD我觉得友军敌军得55开），比如枪械腰射时子弹并不朝着准星飞，比如游戏的一切火力都有友军伤害（视察前线被狙击炮塔打冷枪遗憾离场）。 而且真论游戏是否好玩，其实比较难说。第一人称主要用于沉浸，所以射击手感姑且可以容忍。但塔防也缺乏决策点，游戏呈现一种玩家堆堆堆，堆完等过关的态势。数值上玩家其实不太缺资源，倒是很缺建造无人机，然而即便建造力稀缺，玩家却不能细致调整建造优先级，导致各种炮塔胡乱摆满就可以了，也没有根据局势灵活应变，调整已经部署的建筑哪个先建哪个后建/哪些保留哪些回收的空间，支援也是全都激活就好，所以接下来全是等无人机建造和通关的垃圾时间。 所以对于一般玩家确实难以推荐。不过游戏还是有吸引人的点，比如其对于火力发射的描绘十分诱人（也是我能接着玩的动力源）。 游戏没有限制炮塔数，所以当一些华丽的炮塔攒多之后，比如防空和反导，那么敌军空袭的时候就可以享受到很绚烂的防空阵地表现。在第一人称下一边听着天上敌机的轰鸣，一边看弹幕和导弹一簇簇往天上飞还是很有乐趣的。 当然也有重型火炮打出一轮高抛弹道，再重重砸到敌军（这里不得不指出，还有友军）的头上，按特定的节奏迸发出很有分量感的爆炸的时候，给人的感觉也很好。 游戏选择了相对简陋的画面，所以也就有比较充裕的搞大场面的空间。和地球防卫军类似的，开发者了解这一点并且没有吝啬的提供了场面，更有第一人称提供沉浸式火力阵地浏览。因此如果是重火力爱好者，比方说觉得重装前哨之类的游戏还行，那还是可以一买。

I'm going to give this one a very early review because my first impression was REALLY good. It really reminds me of Supreme Commander 2. It has great UE5 graphics, runs smoothly, has tons of chaos. If you enjoyed AE1, you definitely need to try this. It is about 70% RTS/Tower defense and 30% FPS, and both aspects are really well executed. Guns feel punch, enemies go down with great animations, explosions are REALLY cool (one of the best hooks IMHO). Played through the tutorial and the first level and I'm loving it so far. Pros: Smooth framerate. Great explosions. Animations are very well done. Models look fantastic. AI voice acting as an AI is.. recursive awesome. I like the voice acting. Simply a great upgrade to AE1, takes what was good and expands on it like a proper sequel should. Cons: It appears you can soft-lock yourself if you don't build the proper miners first and run out of certain materials to build more miners. You build so many things, it is difficult to distinguish where you have good turret cover (e.g. where is the anti-air, anti-ground, production buildings). They are all blue and bleed together. Half my tech is locked and I can't figure out how to unlock it (the tutorial covers this, you activate some kind of tower, but I forgot how to do it while in the first mission). TLDR: UI can be confusing in some contexts at times. Would like to see more particles/debris from explosions.

Finished the tutorial and first level. The voices, even if they are AI, aren't a problem. You're playing as a robot, your commander is a robot, we're all robots! I failed a few times, but after restarting and adjusting my playstyle, the game opens up in surprising ways. For example, each time you restart a level, the starting position of the base is moved. This changes your playstyle depending on terrain elevations and the placement of upgrade buildings you'll need to supply power to. The game has some rough edges, but for $15, I'm enjoying it immensely. Edit: Finished a few more levels. There's a good mix of level designs, and technology is introduced as you progress. The story isn't great, but the [spoiler] math [/spoiler] joke at the end of level [spoiler] four [/spoiler] was nice.

The game is still very early access and it can tell a lot of systems seem unfinished but ignoring that it's still very fun especially considering There is not many FPS tower defense hybrids so it's a treat when I do get one

Ha perdido la esencia que tenia AE1, en AE1 se priorizaba mas la calidad de la defensa que en la cantidad, lo que hacia que pudieses disfrutar bien de los gráficos y explosiones del juego, en AE2 mi gameplay ha sido básicamente construir muchas torretas sin importar de que tipo fuesen ya que te las van a destruir igualmente hasta tal punto de que como solo hay un dron para construir la cola es tan larga que destruyen mas rápido que construyen, así que enseguida te cansas del juego ya que todas las partidas dan la sensación de ser iguales aunque los enemigos sean distintos. Aunque es jugable, hay fallos que corregir, sintiéndolo mucho por ahora no puedo recomendar este juego, le daré una segunda oportunidad con futuras actualizaciones. It has lost the essence that AE1 had. In AE1, defense quality was prioritized over quantity, which allowed you to actually enjoy the game's graphics and explosions. In AE2, my gameplay has basically consisted of building tons of turrets regardless of their type, since they're going to get destroyed anyway. It gets to a point where, because there's only one construction drone, the queue is so long that they destroy things faster than you can build them. You quickly get tired of the game because every match feels exactly the same, even if the enemies are different. While it's playable, there are bugs that need fixing. I'm sorry, but for now I can't recommend this game. Great game. I played the demo a lot before deciding to buy the full game. Really good blend of RTS and FPS. One reviewer on YouTube said he found the UI the worst he'd ever seen but didn't give any reasons why. I don't agree and find it intuitive and easy to use especially when you need to make quick decisions. The price is right for this and each run through is unique. Kudos to the developer for providing a demo. I wish more did this but I do appreciate Steams 2 hour trial period. This runs well on Steam Deck with medium settings and FSR scaling. I'll be playing this game for a while.

This is going to be a no. just so many small bad design decisions or balance problems while also being quite shallow in the game play loop. My main gripes: No Ability to customize Turret Priority: How is this a 'tower defense' yet I can't tell my turret 'hey focus the strongest, the healthiest, the weakest, the closest the furthest...' all basic staples of Tower defense yet absent here? So that big guy just screwing your turrets over? Not focused because some infantry guy is slightly closer but behind enough cover your turrets never hit them and die while getting picked off. Anti-drones: they're anti drone killing. They have tracking on the missiles except most drones have further range and way tighter turn radius so they easily get away from missiles. So it's not if they'll damage you but how much your going to get damaged. Anti-drones are Useless, and your better off just spamming sniper turrets to protect from ground units and hope the Emerge drone can do something the DEDICATED Turret can not do Organic terrain: Organic terrain is cool, if you understand sightlines. enemies will peak around and have some cover, neat, except my sniper turret doesn't know how to prioritize what is visible. So your sniper turrets will shoot near center mass and you'll watch as your snipers just shoot terrain while being picked off one by one. Or the emerge drone being useless and maps with lots of valleys and paths, since it either won't track them or hit them cause of terrain. The UI: It feels like it was made as a student project who's learning how to make something that is functionable over looking good to get basics down, which great for a student project, not a released game. You're going to give me 'alerts' where a turret is destroyed or damaged but no way for me to click the alert so I can be taken to WHERE IT WAS DESTROYED?!?! okay cool i just lost a bunch of turrets, I better hope I can remember exactly where all my turrets are so I can replace them. Battle View; what? Was this like a last minute idea? I can't control which unit I view, I can't swap between things manually I just have to spam Q until I get a turret I want to view... for some reason, like genuinely ask yourself what is the purpose of this? does it help the player? can the player use it to control turrets? Does it give the turret an advantage? or is it something for the player to just... have because it's there? My list goes on from the 'playable character' to weapons, to quickly bottomed out gameplay where your just fighting the game and not the enemies. I expected more from a sequel. I wish this was better. I really wanted to like this, but I Just can't.

Reader beware: This is a critique of the game aimed as feedback for the developer. I may bring up things that don't make much sense without the context of playing. In spite of recent updates, Dropships and Railgun Mech Bombers are still completely busted. The fact that the ONLY thing that can actively shoot them down is the SAM site is... not great, considering that they often are far more numerous than drones... and your only placeable AA is effective against drones, and ONLY drones. The game wouldn't be too bad if the Anti-Drones could destroy dropships, or, hell, even if we had a placeable shield to protect our energy production. Not to mention all generators have a deceptively large explosion radius, which is not properly shown ingame, something that looks nearly twice as far away as the UI suggests can still be daisy-chained by another explosive. The fixed limit on energy towers means that with bad RNG, a massive amount of resources can be completely out of range for you-- not to mention the way resources spawns means it can spawn directly UNDER the enemy teleporter towers, making them impossible to access. Resources are confusing to look at-- there's no really good way to tell just how much of a resource you're using until you completely run out of it, and if you run out of ANY of the resources (there are four of them, 3 that you mine which function completely identically, and energy, which can only be produced in generators that are extremely prone to exploding at the mildest amount of gunfire). Truly, the game could have just Energy, and Metal, and it'd lose basically nothing except some annoying contrivance. The first game had this, and it was (mostly) fine for it. If I could concentrate the feedback I have: Make Anti-Drone turrets target/be able to destroy dropships and bombers, or have Sniper Mechs summon drones, instead of dropships Simplify resources; Metal, and Energy. Thorium and Uranium are kinda pointless, since the whole mechanic of 'some weapons use more resources' doesn't really... do anything, when every gun requires basically the exact same materials. Make placeable shields to protect fragile assets like energy generators Allow for more than 10 energy towers-- or have the cost to place new energy towers gradually increase over time, or SOMETHING. Just so we can cover all the areas we need to! Make resources spawn closer to the player's base, or at least not directly under enemy teleporters. Thanks for reading, don't take this as me raging or thinking you did a bad job-- it's just that there was some mistakes (I feel) when the game was designed that made it difficult for me to enjoy it fully.

我推荐这个游戏的理由是该游戏具备潜力，但是项目组似乎不太明白如何从游玩者的角度去设计游戏。游戏中火箭炮台和激光炮台很容易被端掉，这导致实际游戏中不会去装这两种炮台；脉冲炮台存在的意义很低，既然游戏有护盾，那么脉冲炮台应该修改为在一定范围内给予其它炮台护盾，或者生成防护力场，让敌人无法攻击到内部的建筑；防空炮应该主要用于导弹拦截，用近防炮才贴合游戏风格，二战的防空炮显然不贴合游戏画面；反无人机炮应当设计一定的命中率，自身的升级应该加装该功能，比如可以设计为满级状态下，有80%的概率必定命中，但这样设计后，导弹速度应该提升，显然现在导弹的速度不够快；火箭炮台不应该平射，而是应该先飞到天上再打击地面目标，这不同于迫击炮，因为它的目的更多的是干掉墙体后面暂时无法直接命中的敌人；狙击炮和轨道炮定位过于重合，应当把狙击炮换为重机枪，轨道炮换为电磁轨道炮并增加特效，这样可以把两者定位完全分开；敌人可以超远程打击（攻击距离比防御塔还高），我不认为这个设计有问题，但应当降低命中率，目前的命中率过高；地雷过于无用，尤其是它需要建造这一问题；修复无人机应当换为一种炮台，让它只能修复一定范围内的建筑，而不是全体图跑；隐身敌人目前的炮台没有反制手段，应该增加反制手段；角色的武器切换问题很严重，应当设置数字按键快速切换到相应的武器，且武器过热速度过快，武器除了初始的武器外，其它武器几乎没用过，可以增加修复枪、建造枪等，狙击枪、榴弹枪目前使用体验十分鸡肋。

我不想用大公司的标准来批判个人独立制作者，但我确实在犹豫是否要退款。 实际上我第一关还没玩完，但是已经觉得有很多玩的不舒服的地方。 作者意思是FPS和RTS的玩法各占50%，但是FPS方面有点太弱了，枪械打两三秒就过热，伤害不高，血量短，没有想打FPS的冲动，希望能调整一下这方面的参数。角色和敌人的受击反馈都不是很好，希望以后会优化。 RTS方面，复制无人机只有一台，节奏实在是太慢了，我除了开局拿芯片以外，其余时间几乎都在RTS界面，其中大部分时间又在等待，不是强度问题，纯粹是节奏有点无聊了。 然后资源的增多或者消耗目前没有显示，平时资源富裕的时候没感觉，但是弹药是直接从资源扣除的，开始消耗弹药的时候资源瞬间就跟不上了，没资源，没弹药，无人机只有一台，主角无力反抗，等死。做个弹药库之类的设施提前储存弹药可能可以缓解这个问题。 然后是设施毁坏的问题，炸了之后找不到是哪里炸了，虽然左边有提示了但是帮助不是很大。要么左边的提示做成可互动的，点一下提示可以把换面跳转到设施的位置。要么设施毁坏的时候原地留下一个蓝图等待修复，无人机修，或者玩家框选修复都可以。 还有设施范围问题，发电机之类的设施是有爆炸范围的，在建造此类设施的时候应该也要能看到其他设施的爆炸范围，最好是设置按键开关是否可见。 希望以后能玩到成熟一点的版本，在防御塔的炮弹海里用第一人称视角协助防守，还是很爽的。 给个人作者留个好评，一个人能做到这个程度不是易事，祝越做越好。

I really want to like this game but tbh it just feels like an early access game. The controls are clunky and the dev has essentially tried to reinvent the wheel. The tech tree is very limited. The variety of structures in the game is very limited. The gameplay is very limiting to the player such that it forces you to build towers together in a specific way always, you have 10 power towers to increase building range but once placed they cannot be removed. There doesn't appear to be any sort of sandbox mode to allow the player to remove friendly fire to get rid of splash dmg or stray missiles. You only get 1 repair drone and 1 construction drone which is extremely limiting All towers use some resource so if a stray missile hits your miner and you're low on resources, it's kind of gg as you can no longer afford a replacement miner. Stray missiles are everywhere in this game as enemy dropships deploy flares so any allied missile will fly off, potentially destroying your miners or generators, and destroying your entire economy if you're unlucky. Ore veins are random generated and miners are large so sometimes you can't use 2 nodes if they're too close together. Some maps can only ever be played with a specific of already limited towers. However, it is a fun showcase for what could be a good game and I'll probably play it occasionally. I would also like to clarify that it is worth the price it is and that I only don't recommend this game as it should be early access and not release. If I could give this a neutral review I would because it's not a bad game especially for the price and the dev does appear to be actively trying to build the game and listen to community advice.

[h1]未来建造与fps融合——《泰坦防线2》[/h1] 泰坦巨兽来袭，你能否抵挡它们的进攻呢？游玩完《泰坦防线2》，我最大的感受就是由游戏以RTS塔防与FPS结合，一方面考验玩家的测验能力，另外一方面则考验玩家的资源利用能力，就FPS实际上还是占比蛮低的。 一进游戏你出生在一片基地中，你要做的目的就是从飞船上收集到芯片，收集芯片后电脑会自动进行解，解码成功，你的母舰将会到来，而这过程中你需要抵挡无数波的敌方进攻。 就拿眼前的地图来说，地上到处存在的石块代表着矿产资源，每一类都有着不同的作用，而这个放电的塔则代表着能量，你需要围绕基地建许多的设施。 就设施而言，就不得不提到游戏中一个非常重要的科技系统了。你可以生产量子计算机来产生科技点数，利用科技点数来解锁相关的设备，比如就防空导弹系统来说，狙击炮塔、反无人机炮塔、反导弹炮塔，这个是必须要设置的 3 个武器。同时一些基础的包括提升采矿机速度，加快能量反应的核反应堆、聚反应堆以及一些火炮系统提升等等，你要做的就是合理规划，让你的防御固若金汤。 就战斗而言，也就是所谓的 FPS 系统。可以看到图上这张图，此时我拿的是基础武器的冲锋枪，这个对敌人士兵可以造成伤害，怎么说呢，子弹又少，也许一发打完都杀不死一个士兵，体验很一般。但是另外一个，这个可是能轰炸敌方飞机的反飞机炮台，这个非常有用，时间又短，你可以连续不断地对敌方的空中飞机进行攻击，但是非常考验你的瞄准和预判，一不小心就打偏了。而这个则是针对敌人装甲类士兵的一个武器，普通攻击对其无法造成伤害，只能用反装甲进行攻击，反装甲一发子弹大概是 90 秒，时间有些略长。当你坚持到最后的时候，你可以选择进行召唤母舰。当母舰来袭，你的一切布置将会全部被摧毁，但同时你的任务就完成了。 整体体验下来，我最大的感受其实就在于策略性，它非常考验玩家的一个策略能力，一方面就是前期资源的利用，另外一方面，根据地图的地形，你可以看到对方的士兵往往是通过两到三条路径来进行攻击的，你需要在他们路径上布置一些合适的道具，甚至来说有一些地雷需要你提前进行设置。同时如果敌方火力过于强大，在FPS 方面还是得需要一些重型武器来帮助你的自动化机械，来减少一些压力。 游玩下来，其实我最大的印象还是智能系统。在教程环节就有一个非常 AI 的男生一直在提示着你操作，在战斗环节，他当然也会对你进行一些关键点的提示，比如说敌袭来袭，比如说还剩多长时间可以完成芯片的研发，甚至在剧情环节还会讲一些关于机器人的故事，我觉得还是蛮有趣的。 [quote]欢迎关注『 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45525570/] 桃你欢心 [/url]』 [b] 桃影扶风评百戏，落墨如歌写人间[/b][/quote]

This game is a fun and unique blend of tower defense and first person shooter. There are some things that I either don't like or just need to get better at, but the developer seems very receptive to player feedback and offering options to play the game the way that you find most enjoyable. The only thing I could really ask for is more of what they're already doing. Compared to the first game, there is more of an emphasis on base building. You aren't forced to play in first person mode and switch seemlessly to top-down view for building. There is a new tech screen, so turret don't need to be upgraded individually (although generators can be). Compared to other tower defense games, your turrets are both sword and shield, so placement is less about maximizing firing arcs and more about concentrating fire at certain natural chokepoints in the terrain while minimizing exposure to enemy fire. It can be challenging and frustrating at times, but I think that's mostly down to the learning curve.

A hearty recommendation from me. For full transparency, I've been a playtester for AE2 for a long while now and have enjoyed every minute of it. I got into the original AE years back and enjoyed its fun change for the tower defense genre by adding free-form tower placement and FPS action. AE2 takes it even further. Now there's more terrain to deal with, more enemy types to overcome, more types of turrets to work with, and more resource management to handle. Tech improvements keep things going changing, and the enemies can and will push your limits. By design, this game isn't meant to be super easy. It's not designed to make you throw your computer out a window, it's not Dark Souls after all. But it still aims to present a real challenge to the player. The dev has been great to work with. Responsive, dedicated and hard working, and willing to try out some different things. There's a definite goal in mind, a vision being worked on, but player feedback both before and after launch has been and continues to be taken seriously. Changes have been made to help adapt to player needs while not turning the game into a no-challenge-zone. I highly respect that. And with how active the dev is over on discord, there's plenty of opportunity for live feedback and discussion (pop on in and say hi). While yes it does still have some rough edges, it's still being worked on and the structure is well built. It's fun to play and it does reward strategic thinking, not just run-and-gun action. Give the demo a spin if you're unsure, but I hope you'll find it to your liking! (and yes, while I did receive a free copy, I also purchased one both to support the dev and because I just like the game that much that I think it deserved my purchase)

Highly engaging, alot of fun. Its like infinity siege, if you could pilot additional RTS units, besides the singular player unit, and also massively limited in what you can build and collect on the field. Outside of that, it is alot of fun, very engaging, and its incredibly easy to forget the loss of time. Personally want faster build times, cool that dev listens, but i prefer heavy automation, and fielded support in any RTS game i play. Some things i'd like to see, additional expanded builder drone, additional repair drone, additional drone that collects dropped resources on the field, player supported drone that follows player to assist in combat. Ability to print out more 'player' units as RTS soldiers with limited AI when in overview/command mode (for better RTS strategy) still consuming resources BUT with a cost (vs your unit). When player unit dies, you take over the nearest unit (or are brought to the command menu to quickly cycle to the unit you want). Also needs additional player unit upgrades (individual unit upgrades not just weapons, but shield generator for the player unit, additional health regeneration or repair at the bunker/base station) of some sort, some kind of healing/repair mechanic for the player RTS printed drones. The additional replay value and game modes are great, but what im suggesting also significantly improves its already fun gameplay, with overwhelmingly more. Especially when revamping the dropped resources to be a rapid paced salvage operation if possible. That said its alot of fun. But the massively dragged out map gameplay modes is incredibly painful. Needs a fast forward function as well. Display issues galore when playing on laptop and using other screens and projectors. Had to put the game in windowed mode, for all the GUI to properly show in the upgrade menu, overworld/build menu, and while playing as the trooper. Was driving me mad till i just left the game in windowed mode. This is NOT something any user should need to put up with to get it graphically sorted. Thats a very bad thing, but once you get past these little quirks its a gem of a game. One more thing, please make the sound track purchasable, it was phenomenal and i loved it while playing. Would like to have that music as additional background music to play at my home office, and on prem office at work.
